settings.title: Settings
settings.languageSaveFailed: The language changed on this device, but could not be saved to your account.
settings.scrapingHint: When a page offers no feed, offer the page itself as a source. Quality depends on the site and can break without notice.
settings.scrapingSaveFailed: The setting changed on this device, but could not be saved to your account.

feeds.title: Feeds
feeds.none: No feeds yet — add one from the reader.
feeds.scrapedHint: Generated from the page's article list — the site offers no feed
feeds.statusErroring: This feed last failed to fetch. A refresh will retry it.
feeds.statusGone: This feed appears gone. A refresh will retry it.

tags.title: Tags
tags.none: No tags yet — create one to group your feeds.

opml.title: Import & export
opml.exportLead: Download all your feeds as an OPML file.
opml.importLead: Import an OPML file, or paste its contents.
opml.result: Imported {{imported}}, already subscribed {{already}}, invalid {{invalid}}, skipped over limit {{skipped}}. New feeds fill in on the next refresh.

account.title: Account
account.deleteNote: Deleting your account removes your subscriptions, tags and read state permanently. Export your feeds first if you want to keep them.
account.deleteMessage: This permanently deletes your account with all subscriptions, tags and read state. This cannot be undone.

ai.title: AI
ai.lead: Connect an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The key is stored encrypted and is never shown again.
ai.baseUrlHint: The full API root, including any version path — for example https://api.openai.com/v1
ai.apiKeyHint: The key is sent once and stored encrypted. Enter it again to replace it.
ai.storedKey: A key ending in {{hint}} is stored.
ai.ready: AI features are available and use {{model}}.

configs.deleteConfirmMessage: This deletes the endpoint, the stored key and the model. AI features stop if this was the active configuration.
configs.reasoning: Ask the model not to reason
configs.reasoningHint: Leave on for most providers. Turn it off only if the endpoint rejects the request (for example a direct OpenAI URL).
configs.batchConcurrencyHint: How many batch prompts to send at once (1–4). Raise it for a hosted provider to speed up a run; leave it at 1 for a local model.

errors.provider: The provider could not be used. Check the endpoint and the key.
errors.unreadableKey: This account's stored API key cannot be read any more. Retrying will not help — enter the key again to restore AI features.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests to the provider. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.notConfigured: Save an endpoint and an API key first.
errors.limit: You have reached the maximum number of saved configurations.

recommendations.title: Recommendations
recommendations.autoGenerateNoWorker: No background worker is running, so the schedule cannot start on its own. Trigger it from an external cron (for example a GitHub Actions schedule) by calling this endpoint with your maintenance token:
recommendations.debugHint: Keeps per-run call logs and shows recommendation scores.
recommendations.debugFinishTruncated: Answer truncated by max_tokens (finish reason: length)
recommendations.debugRunSummary: attempts {{ a }}/{{ am }} · transport {{ t }}/{{ tm }}
recommendations.purgeExplain: Removes every recommended post from “For you”. A new run rebuilds the list.

about.title: About
about.stale: Your browser is running an older build than the server. Reload the page to update.

instance.title: Instance settings
instance.requireEmailConfirmationHint: New accounts must confirm their email address before they can sign in.
instance.requireApprovalHint: New accounts stay pending until an admin approves them.
instance.mailDisabledHint: This instance sends no mail, so email confirmation cannot run — approve accounts by hand instead.

addFeed.title: Add a feed
addFeed.foundPick: We found these feeds — pick one:
addFeed.scrapedHint: No feed found — generated from the page's article list.
addFeed.noneFound: No feeds found at that address.
addFeed.failBlocked: This site blocks automated access — it can't be subscribed.
addFeed.failThrottled: This site is limiting requests right now — wait a moment and try again.
addFeed.failUnreachable: The site couldn't be reached — check the address or try again later.
addFeed.failNotScrapable: This page offers no feed and no article list could be detected — it can't be subscribed.

editFeed.title: Edit feed
editFeed.noTags: No tags yet — create one from Settings › Tags.

manage.unsubscribeMessage: Remove “{{title}}” and its entries from your feeds?
manage.deleteTagMessage: Delete “{{name}}”? It will be removed from every feed that uses it.

admin.title: Users
admin.catalogEmpty: This catalog is empty, so new users are not being offered any suggestions.
admin.importBundled: Import the bundled catalog ({{categories}} categories, {{feeds}} feeds)
admin.importModeMerge: Merge — add and update, keep everything else
admin.importModeReplace: Replace — also delete entries this file does not list (locked entries are kept)
admin.lockedHint: Locked entries survive an import untouched — neither overwritten nor deleted.

confirm.rejectMessage: Reject {{email}}? They will not be able to sign in.
confirm.suspendMessage: Suspend {{email}}? Their access is blocked until re-approved.
confirm.deleteMessage: This permanently deletes {{email}} with all subscriptions, tags and read state. Feeds nobody else reads are deleted too. This cannot be undone.

confirmDelete.categoryMessage: Delete "{{name}}" and every feed in it?

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back to your reader.
login.invalidInput: Please enter a valid email and password.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Register, then confirm your email.
register.checkEmail: Check your email for a confirmation link. After you confirm, an administrator reviews your account before you can sign in.
register.awaitingApproval: An administrator needs to approve your account before you can sign in.
register.activeNow: Your account is ready. You can sign in now.
register.invalidInput: Enter a valid email address and a password of at least 12 characters.

reset.requestSubtitle: We’ll email you a reset link.
reset.requestDone: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. The link is valid for 24 hours.
reset.linkInvalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
reset.failed: Could not reset the password. Request a new link.
reset.newInvalidInput: Enter a password of at least 12 characters.
reset.unavailable: Password reset is unavailable on this instance. Ask your administrator to reset your password.

verify.title: Confirm email
verify.ok: Your email is confirmed. An administrator will review your account before you can sign in.
verify.invalid: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired.

oauth.title: Signing you in
oauth.error: Sign-in did not complete. Please try again.
oauth.pendingApproval: Your account was created. An administrator must approve it before you can sign in.
oauth.pendingVerification: Confirm your email address before you sign in.
oauth.suspended: This account is suspended. Ask your administrator for help.
oauth.rejected: This account was rejected. Ask your administrator for help.
oauth.blocked: This account cannot sign in. Ask your administrator for help.

reader.fetchFailed: Some feeds could not be fetched.
reader.refreshBusy: Another refresh is already running. Try again in a moment.
reader.refreshAborted: The refresh stopped early. Some feeds are still due.
reader.refreshStalled: The refresh stopped making progress. Some feeds are still due — try again in a few minutes.
reader.readerFallback: Couldn't load the full article — showing the feed's summary.
reader.forYouRunConfirmMessage: This ranks your unread posts with AI. It can take several minutes.
reader.forYouUnfinishedTitle: You have an unfinished recommendation run
reader.forYouUnreachable: Could not reach the recommendation service. Try again.

discover.title: Discover feeds
discover.subtitle: Pick a few to get started — you can always add more later
discover.loadFailed: The catalog could not be loaded.
discover.emptyCatalog: No suggestions have been set up yet. An administrator can import a catalog from the admin area.
discover.adminEmptyWarning: No feed catalog has been imported, so new users are not being offered any suggestions.

setup.title: Set up this instance
setup.subtitle: Create the first administrator account.
setup.secretHint: Paste the ADMIN_SETUP_SECRET you configured in the environment. Prefer a shell? Run bin/console app:admin:create instead.
setup.invalidInput: Enter a valid email, a password of at least 12 characters, and the setup secret.
setup.failed: Setup failed. Check the secret and try again.
